cases.name: setup: create story + seed bug
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"binding-test",title:"Binding",description:"test",type:"feature",priority:"high"}); $ctx.sid = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; $ctx.bugSeedId="BUG-SEED-"+Date.now(); $handlers.bug_report({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:$ctx.bugSeedId,title:"seeded bug",fixtureId:"fid-"+Date.now()}); return r

cases.name: bug_list returns bugs with valid status
cases.execute: const bugs = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}).bugs; return bugs.every(b => b.status === 'open' || b.status === 'fixed')

cases.name: all bugs have valid status after test_auto
cases.execute: const s = await $handlers.story_create({name:"done-ok",title:"Done OK",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"TEST"}); const sid = s.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; try { $handlers.story_advance({storyId:sid,phase:"DONE"}); return true; } catch(e) { return !e.message.includes("bug 未修复"); }

cases.name: bug_report rejects duplicate ID on same story
cases.execute: const bid = "BUG-stable-"+Date.now(); $handlers.bug_report({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:bid,title:"first",fixtureId:"fid-"+Date.now()}); const c1 = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}).bugs.length; try { $handlers.bug_report({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:bid,title:"dup",fixtureId:"fid2-"+Date.now()}); } catch {} const c2 = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}).bugs.length; return c1 === c2

cases.name: open bugs have null fixedAt
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}); const open = r.bugs.filter(b => b.status === 'open'); const fixed = r.bugs.filter(b => b.status === 'fixed'); return open.every(b => b.fixedAt === null) && fixed.every(b => typeof b.fixedAt === 'string')

cases.name: bugs are retrievable by storyId
cases.execute: const s = await $handlers.story_create({name:"done-fail",title:"Done Fail",description:"t",type:"feature",priority:"high",phase:"TEST"}); const sid = s.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; $handlers.bug_report({storyId:sid,id:"BUG-BLOCK-"+Date.now(),title:"blocking bug",fixtureId:"fid-"+Date.now()}); try { $handlers.story_advance({storyId:sid,phase:"DONE"}); return false; } catch(e) { return e.message.includes("Cannot enter DONE"); }

cases.name: bug_list on new story returns empty
cases.execute: const sid = await $testStory(); const r = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:sid}); return r.bugs.length === 0

cases.name: bug_report and bug_list complete roundtrip
cases.execute: const bid = "BUG-rt-"+Date.now(); $handlers.bug_report({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:bid,title:"roundtrip",fixtureId:"fid-"+Date.now()}); const r = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}); const found = r.bugs.find(b => b.id === bid); return found && found.title === "roundtrip" && found.status === "open"

cases.name: bug_update with nonexistent bug ID throws
cases.execute: try { await $handlers.bug_update({storyId:$ctx.sid,id:"BUG-ghost-"+Date.now(),status:"fixed"}); return false; } catch(e) { return e.message.includes("not found") || e.message.includes("Bug"); }
